new_standard.title: Black Pepper, Whole and Ground — Specification

new_standard.performance_requirements: Pungent characteristic aroma, zero mould growth, freedom from mineral oil coating.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Moisture per IS 1797, piperine by HPLC per ISO 5564, total ash per IS 1797.

new_standard.title: Pasteurized Milk — Specification
new_standard.scope: Prescribes requirements and methods of test for pasteurized milk (Full Cream, Toned, Double Toned, and Skimmed milk).
new_standard.materials: Raw cow or buffalo milk pasteurized by HTST or holder method.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Milk fat (min 6.0% for Full Cream / 3.0% for Toned), solids-not-fat SNF (min 9.0% / 8.5%), titratable acidity, phosphatase test (negative), methylene blue reduction time.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Standard plate count <= 30,000 cfu/ml, coliform count <= 10 cfu/ml, zero adulterants (neutralizers, urea, starch absent).
new_standard.testing_requirements: Phosphatase test per IS 1479 (Part 2), fat by Gerber method per IS 1224, SNF per lactometer formula.

new_standard.performance_requirements: Total plate count <= 30,000 cfu/g, coliform absent in 0.1 g, Salmonella absent in 25 g.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Protein by Kjeldahl per IS 1479, solubility index per IS 12759, scorched particle test per IS 13500.

new_standard.title: Sunflower Oil — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements for raw and refined sunflower oil obtained from seeds of Helianthus annuus L.
new_standard.materials: Refined and winterized oil from sunflower seeds.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Refractive index at 40°C (1.4640 to 1.4800), saponification value (188 to 194), iodine value (100 to 145), acid value (max 0.5 for refined), unsaponifiable matter (max 1.5%), wax content.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Clear pale yellow oil remaining clear at 10°C (dewaxed); high linoleic/oleic polyunsaturated fatty acid profile.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Wax test per Annex B, acid value and iodine value per IS 548 (Part 1).
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards FAD 4 / FSSAI

mapping.evidence_source: FSSAI Edible Oils Regulations; BIS FAD 4 Specifications
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Prescribes quality and refining parameters for sunflower cooking oil.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national standard for refined sunflower cooking oil.

new_standard.title: Black Tea — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements for black tea (CTC and orthodox) produced from leaves of Camellia sinensis.
new_standard.materials: Processed dried tea leaves, buds and tender stems.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Water extract (min 32.0%), total ash (4.0% to 8.0%), water soluble ash in total ash (min 45.0%), acid insoluble ash (max 1.0%), crude fibre (max 16.5%), alkalinity of water soluble ash.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Characteristic brisk cup quality, liquor colour and aroma; zero exhausted tea leaves or added colouring matter.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Water extract per IS 1386, crude fibre per IS 10226, total ash per IS 1385.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards FAD 6 / Tea Board of India

mapping.evidence_source: Tea Board of India Quality Regulations; FSSAI Beverages Regulations
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Prescribes chemical and quality criteria for commercial black tea in CTC grain and orthodox leaf forms.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national standard for CTC black tea.

new_standard.title: Green Tea — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements for green tea produced by unfermented steaming/pan-firing of Camellia sinensis leaves.
new_standard.materials: Non-fermented tender tea leaves and buds.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Water extract (min 32.0%), total ash (4.0% to 8.0%), catechins/polyphenol content (min 15.0%), crude fibre (max 16.5%), moisture (max 8.0%).
new_standard.performance_requirements: Bright green infusion liquor, grassy vegetal taste; high antioxidant epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG) content.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Catechins by HPLC per ISO 14502-2, water extract per IS 1386.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards FAD 6 / Tea Board of India

mapping.evidence_source: Tea Board of India Quality Regulations; FSSAI Regulations
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Prescribes quality requirements and antioxidant parameters for unfermented green tea.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national standard for green tea.

new_standard.title: Soluble Coffee Powder — Specification
new_standard.scope: Prescribes requirements for spray-dried and freeze-dried pure soluble (instant) coffee powder.
new_standard.materials: Aqueous extract of pure roasted and ground coffee beans (Coffea arabica or Coffea canephora).
new_standard.technical_requirements: Moisture (max 4.0%), total ash (7.0% to 14.0%), caffeine content (min 2.8% on dry basis), solubility in boiling water (complete within 30 seconds), solubility in cold water at 16°C (complete within 3 minutes).
new_standard.performance_requirements: Instant dissolution without sediment; characteristic roasted coffee aroma; zero chicory or added starch in pure grade.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Caffeine determination by spectrophotometry/HPLC per IS 2791 Annex B, solubility test per Annex C.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards FAD 6 / Coffee Board

mapping.evidence_source: Coffee Board of India Regulations; FSSAI Beverages Regulations
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Prescribes purity, caffeine content and instant dissolution parameters for pure soluble coffee powder.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national standard for pure instant coffee powder.

new_standard.title: Roasted and Ground Coffee — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements for pure roasted and ground coffee powder without chicory.
new_standard.materials: Roasted beans of Coffea arabica or Coffea robusta.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Moisture (max 5.0%), total ash (3.5% to 5.0%), water soluble ash in total ash (min 65.0%), acid insoluble ash (max 0.5%), caffeine content (min 1.0%), petroleum ether extract.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Full-bodied aromatic brew; microscopic freedom from chicory root or date seed adulterants.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Microscopic examination per IS 3077 Annex B, caffeine per Annex C, moisture per IS 4333.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards FAD 6 / Coffee Board

mapping.evidence_source: Coffee Board of India Regulations; FSSAI Regulations
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Prescribes purity and roasting standards for pure ground filter coffee powder.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national standard for roasted and ground coffee powder.

new_standard.title: Carbonated Beverages — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements and test methods for carbonated beverages (fruit flavoured drinks, colas, ginger ale, soda water).
new_standard.materials: Potable water conforming to IS 10500, dissolved carbon dioxide, permitted flavourings, sweeteners, and citric/malic acids.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Carbonation volume (gas volume min 1.0 to 4.0 vols), total soluble solids TSS (Brix), pH (2.5 to 4.0), microbiological limits, heavy metals (lead <= 0.5 ppm, arsenic <= 0.25 ppm).
new_standard.performance_requirements: Effervescent sparkle; zero coliforms or pathogenic bacteria.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Gas volume measurement by manometer per Annex B, Brix by refractometer, microbiological tests per IS 5402.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards FAD 14 / FSSAI

mapping.evidence_source: FSSAI Carbonated Fruit Beverages Regulations; BIS FAD 14 Specifications
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Prescribes quality and hygiene requirements for commercially bottled carbonated beverages.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national standard for carbonated fruit-flavoured drinks.

new_standard.title: Canned Mango Pulp — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements for canned mango pulp prepared from sound ripe fruits of mango varieties (Alphonso, Totapuri, Kesar).
new_standard.materials: Extracted mango fruit pulp packed in hermetically sealed sanitary tinplate cans.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Total soluble solids TSS (min 19.0 Brix for Alphonso), acidity as citric acid (0.3% to 0.8%), vacuum in can (min 100 mm Hg), headspace (max 10%), heavy metals (tin <= 250 ppm, lead <= 1.0 ppm).
new_standard.performance_requirements: Characteristic bright orange-yellow colour and natural aroma; commercial sterility (zero viable thermophilic or mesophilic spores).
new_standard.testing_requirements: TSS by refractometer, acidity per IS 2860, incubation sterility test at 37°C and 55°C per IS 2860.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards FAD 10 / APEDA Processed Food Guidelines

mapping.evidence_source: APEDA Export Standards for Canned Mango Pulp; FSSAI Fruit Products Regulations
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Alphonso mango pulp canning quality and export consignments conform to IS 3882.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national standard for canned mango fruit pulp.

new_standard.title: Canned Sweet Corn — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements for canned sweet corn kernels (whole kernel style in brine and cream style) packed in hermetically sealed containers.
new_standard.materials: Cut whole kernels of tender sweet corn (Zea mays var. saccharata) in potable water and edible salt brine.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Drained weight (min 60% of net water capacity), alcohol-insoluble solids (max 27%), vacuum (min 100 mm Hg), defects (blemished kernels max 2%).
new_standard.performance_requirements: Tender crisp kernels, bright yellow colour; commercially sterile.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Drained weight per IS 2860, alcohol-insoluble solids per Annex B, sterility test.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards FAD 10 / FSSAI

mapping.evidence_source: FSSAI Processed Vegetables Regulations; BIS FAD 10 Specifications
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Prescribes requirements for canned whole kernel sweet corn in brine.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national standard for canned sweet corn.

new_standard.title: Tomato Puree and Tomato Paste — Specification
new_standard.scope: Prescribes requirements for concentrated tomato products (tomato puree min 9% TSS; tomato paste min 25% to 36% TSS hot-break and cold-break).
new_standard.materials: Concentrated tomato juice from sound red ripe tomatoes (Solanum lycopersicum).
new_standard.technical_requirements: Total soluble solids TSS (min 25.0% to 36.0% salt-free solids for paste), acidity (min 1.0%), Howard mould count (max 40% positive fields), lycopene content, Bostwick consistency.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Deep red colour, thick consistency; zero added artificial red colour or starch.
new_standard.testing_requirements: TSS by Abbe refractometer, Howard mould count per IS 2860, Bostwick consistometer test.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards FAD 10 / FSSAI

mapping.evidence_source: FSSAI Fruit and Vegetable Products Regulations; BIS FAD 10 Specifications
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Prescribes concentration, mould count and purity parameters for tomato paste and puree.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national standard for tomato paste and puree concentrates.

mapping.evidence_source: FSSAI Regulations; BIS FAD 10
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Clause 1: Prescribes requirements for tomato puree and concentrated tomato products.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national standard for tomato purees and tomato sauce bases.

new_standard.title: Jams, Jellies and Marmalades — Specification
new_standard.scope: Prescribes requirements and test methods for fruit jams, fruit jellies, and citrus marmalades.
new_standard.materials: Prepared fruit pulp/juice boiled with sucrose, pectin, and citric acid.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Total soluble solids TSS (min 65.0% by mass), fruit content (min 45.0% of finished product), sulfur dioxide preservative (max 40 ppm), lead (max 1.0 ppm).
new_standard.performance_requirements: Firm tender gel holding shape without syneresis (weeping); zero mould growth.
new_standard.testing_requirements: TSS by refractometer, fruit content determination per Annex B, preservative test per IS 2860.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards FAD 10 / FSSAI

mapping.evidence_source: FSSAI Fruit Products Regulations; BIS FAD 10 Specifications
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Prescribes composition, minimum fruit content and soluble solids for fruit jams and marmalades.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national standard for fruit jams, jellies and marmalades.

new_standard.title: Instant Noodles — Specification
new_standard.scope: Prescribes requirements and test methods for fried and non-fried instant noodles with accompanying seasoning tastemaker sachet.
new_standard.materials: Refined wheat flour (maida), edible vegetable oil, seasoning spices, permitted acidity regulators.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Moisture (max 10.0% for fried / 12.0% for non-fried), acid value of extracted fat (max 2.0 mg KOH/g), lead content (max 2.5 mg/kg), total ash, microbiological limits.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Rapid rehydration in boiling water within 3 minutes; chewy resilient texture without mushiness.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Acid value of extracted oil per IS 548, lead by AAS per AOAC 999.11, rehydration cooking test.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards FAD 16 / FSSAI Instant Noodles Standard

mapping.evidence_source: FSSAI Cereal Products Regulations; BIS FAD 16 Specifications
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Prescribes quality and safety standards for instant noodles and seasoning sachets.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national standard for instant noodles.

new_standard.title: Dehydrated Garlic — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements for dehydrated garlic in flakes, granules, minced, and powder forms prepared from Allium sativum L.
new_standard.materials: Dehydrated cloves of Allium sativum L.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Moisture (max 6.0%), total ash (max 5.0%), acid insoluble ash (max 0.5%), cold water soluble extract (min 70.0%), volatile thiosulphinates (allicin potential min 0.3%).
new_standard.performance_requirements: Strong characteristic pungent garlic odour upon reconstitution; free from scorching or caking.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Moisture by toluene distillation per IS 1797, allicin assay by spectrophotometry.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards FAD 10 / APEDA

mapping.evidence_source: APEDA Dehydrated Vegetables Export Standards; FSSAI Regulations
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Prescribes quality requirements for dehydrated garlic flakes, granules and powder.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national standard for dehydrated garlic products.

new_standard.title: Dehydrated Onion — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements for dehydrated onion flakes, kibbled pieces, and powder prepared from clean mature white or red onions (Allium cepa L.).
new_standard.materials: Dehydrated bulbs of Allium cepa L.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Moisture (max 6.0%), total ash (max 5.0%), acid insoluble ash (max 0.5%), rehydration ratio (min 1:4), pyruvic acid content (pungency indicator).
new_standard.performance_requirements: Light cream colour, free from scorching; clean savoury onion taste upon rehydration.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Rehydration test per Annex B, pyruvic acid assay per Annex C, moisture per IS 1797.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards FAD 10 / APEDA

mapping.evidence_source: APEDA Dehydrated Onion Export Guidelines; FSSAI Regulations
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Prescribes quality and rehydration standards for dehydrated onion flakes and powder.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national standard for dehydrated white onion flakes.

new_standard.title: Compounded Feeds for Cattle — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements and test methods for compounded cattle feeds (Type I and Type II) in mash or pellet form for milk-producing cows and buffaloes.
new_standard.materials: Grains, oilseed cakes (mustard, soy, cotton), wheat bran, molasses, mineral mixture, and vitamins.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Crude protein (min 20.0% for Type I / 18.0% for Type II), crude fat (min 2.5% to 3.0%), crude fibre (max 12.0%), acid insoluble ash (max 3.0%), aflatoxin B1 (max 20 ppb), urea (max 1.0%).
new_standard.performance_requirements: High palatability, promotes lactation milk yield; zero pathogenic Salmonella or toxic castor pomace.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Crude protein by Kjeldahl per IS 7874 (Part 1), aflatoxin by HPLC/ELISA per IS 13426.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards FAD 5 / Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying (DAHD)

mapping.evidence_source: DPIIT / DAHD Compounded Cattle Feeds (Quality Control) Order; National Dairy Development Board
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Compulsory Scheme-I ISI marking for compounded cattle feeds conforming to IS 2052 across commercial dairy feed mills.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory product specification for dairy cow compounded cattle feeds.

Compounded Cattle Feed for Dairy Cows.investigation_notes: Formulated by FAD 5. Mandatory ISI mark under DAHD Quality Control Order.

new_standard.title: Poultry Feeds — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements for poultry feeds (Broiler Starter, Broiler Finisher, Layer Starter, Grower and Layer Feeds).
new_standard.materials: Corn, soybean meal, fish meal, dicalcium phosphate, amino acids (methionine, lysine), trace minerals.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Crude protein (min 20.0% for broiler finisher), metabolisable energy ME (min 3100 kcal/kg), crude fat (min 3.5%), crude fibre (max 5.0%), calcium, available phosphorus, aflatoxin B1 (max 20 ppb).
new_standard.performance_requirements: Optimal feed conversion ratio (FCR <= 1.6); free from fungal mycotoxins and mammalian tissue meat meal.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Crude protein per IS 7874 (Part 1), gross energy by bomb calorimeter, aflatoxin screening.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards FAD 5 Animal Feeds Committee

mapping.evidence_source: BIS FAD 5 Sectional Committee Specifications; DAHD Poultry Guidelines
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Clause 1: Prescribes nutritional and hygiene requirements for balanced poultry feeds.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national standard for broiler finisher poultry feeds.

new_standard.title: Fish Feeds — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements and test methods for aquaculture fish feeds (floating extruded pellets and sinking pellets for carps, pangasius, and tilapia).
new_standard.materials: Fish meal, soy protein concentrate, wheat flour, fish oil, vitamins and minerals extruded under high pressure/temperature.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Crude protein (24% to 38% depending on growth stage), crude fat (min 4.0% to 8.0%), floatability (min 90% floating after 20 minutes in water), water stability without disintegrating.
new_standard.performance_requirements: High digestibility, minimal nutrient leaching into pond water; zero prohibited antibiotics.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Floatability test per Annex B, water stability per Annex C, crude protein per IS 7874.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards FAD 5 Animal Feeds Committee

mapping.evidence_source: National Fisheries Development Board (NFDB) Standards; BIS FAD 5
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Prescribes nutrient composition and physical water-stability for manufactured aquaculture fish feeds.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national standard for extruded floating fish feed pellets.

new_standard.title: Mineral Mixtures for Supplementing Cattle Feeds — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements and test methods for mineral mixtures containing macro-minerals and micro-minerals (Type I containing salt and Type II without salt) for cattle and buffaloes.
new_standard.materials: Calcite powder, dicalcium phosphate, copper sulphate, zinc sulphate, manganese sulphate, potassium iodate, cobalt sulphate.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Calcium (min 16.0% to 20.0%), phosphorus (min 6.0% to 9.0%), magnesium, copper, zinc, manganese, iodine, fluorine (max 0.05% to prevent fluorosis), lead (max 20 ppm), arsenic (max 7 ppm).
new_standard.performance_requirements: Prevents mineral deficiency diseases and reproductive disorders in livestock; non-hygroscopic free flowing.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Calcium and phosphorus per IS 7874 (Part 2), fluorine by ion selective electrode, heavy metals by AAS.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards FAD 5 / DAHD Compulsory Scheme

mapping.evidence_source: DPIIT / DAHD Mineral Mixtures for Cattle Feeds (Quality Control) Order
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Compulsory Scheme-I ISI marking for mineral mixtures for cattle feeds conforming to IS 1664.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory product specification for livestock mineral mixtures.

Mineral Mixture for Livestock Feeds.investigation_notes: Formulated by FAD 5. Mandatory ISI mark under DAHD QCO.

new_standard.title: Round Open Top Sanitary Cans for Foods and Drinks — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements for three-piece welded and two-piece drawn open-top sanitary tinplate metal cans for packing preserved fruits, vegetables, meat, and fish.
new_standard.materials: Electrolytic tinplate conforming to IS 1993 lined with food-grade epoxy-phenolic or organosol sanitary lacquer.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Can dimensions, double seam parameters (seam thickness, seam length, body hook, cover hook, overlap min 1.0 mm), axial load bearing capacity, internal lacquer adhesion and curing test.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Hermetic seal holding vacuum; zero migration of bisphenol A or heavy metals into foodstuffs.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Cross-hatch lacquer adhesion test, enamel rater conductivity test, double seam tear-down inspection.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards FAD 10 / FSSAI Packaging Regulations

mapping.evidence_source: FSSAI Packaging Regulations; BIS FAD 10 Specifications
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Prescribes dimensional and double seam hermetic seal requirements for open top sanitary food cans.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national standard for food grade sanitary tinplate cans.

new_standard.title: General Requirements for Silos for Grain Storage: Part 1 Constructional Requirements
new_standard.scope: Specifies constructional and design requirements for outdoor corrugated galvanized steel silos for bulk food grain storage.
new_standard.materials: Corrugated hot-dip galvanized steel wall sheets (IS 277 Z450 coating) with structural steel stiffeners.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Wind and seismic load resistance, grain pressure computation (Janssen theory), aeration ducts, moisture sealing at base joint, roof slope and emergency pressure relief vents.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Airtight fumigation capability, zero grain spoilage or hotspot formation; 30+ year structural design life.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Structural design check, zinc coating thickness per IS 6745, air tightness pressure decay test.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards FAD 17 / Food Corporation of India (FCI) Silo Tenders

mapping.evidence_source: FCI Bulk Grain Silo Technical Specifications; BIS FAD 17 Standards
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Prescribes design and construction requirements for galvanized steel grain storage silos.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national standard for corrugated steel grain storage silos.

new_standard.title: Agricultural Machinery — Power Tillers — Test Code
new_standard.scope: Specifies test procedures and performance requirements for hand-operated two-wheel power tillers (rotary tillers driven by diesel engines).
new_standard.materials: Steel chassis, diesel engine, gearbox, rotary cultivation rotor blades.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Engine power output, PTO power, drawbar pull, fuel consumption, turning radius, vibration and operator noise limits at handle grip, rotary tilling efficiency.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Safe maneuvering in wet paddy puddling; operator hand-arm vibration attenuation.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Laboratory and field testing protocol at FMTTI Budni per IS 9980 and IS 13539.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards FAD 11 / Ministry of Agriculture SMAM

mapping.evidence_source: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM) Subsidy Guidelines; Central Motor Vehicles Rules (CMVR)
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Compulsory testing and conformity to IS 9980 / IS 13539 at FMTTI for all power tillers commercialized or subsidized in India.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory testing and performance standard for power tillers in India.

Power Tillers (Hand Tractors).investigation_notes: Formulated by FAD 11. Mandatory under Ministry of Agriculture SMAM scheme.

new_standard.title: Agricultural Tractors and Other Self-Propelled Machines — Combine Harvester — Test Code
new_standard.scope: Specifies test codes and performance evaluation for self-propelled wheeled and track-type combine harvesters for harvesting paddy and wheat.
new_standard.materials: Heavy structural steel frame, diesel engine, cutter bar reel, threshing cylinder, concave, straw walkers, grain cleaning sieves.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Cutter bar width, grain throughput capacity (t/h), grain loss limits (cutter bar loss <= 1%, unthreshed loss <= 0.5%, blower loss <= 0.5%), grain damage/breakage (max 2.0%), operator cab safety ROPS.
new_standard.performance_requirements: High harvesting efficiency with clean grain bin output; compliance with CMVR road safety regulations.
new_standard.testing_requirements: FMTTI field test code: 25 hours continuous harvesting test, grain loss evaluation per Annex B.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards FAD 11 / Ministry of Agriculture SMAM

mapping.evidence_source: Ministry of Agriculture SMAM Guidelines; FMTTI Test Protocol
mapping.evidence_excerpt: All combine harvesters sold in India must undergo mandatory commercial testing conforming to IS 15806.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory performance and testing code for combine harvesters in India.

Combine Harvesters (Paddy/Wheat).investigation_notes: Formulated by FAD 11. Mandatory for commercial sale and agricultural subsidy.

new_standard.title: Agricultural Machinery — Rubber Tracks for Crawlers — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements, dimensions and test methods for endless rubber crawler tracks used on paddy combine harvesters and agricultural crawler tractors.
new_standard.materials: Abrasion-resistant vulcanized rubber compound reinforced with continuous high-tensile steel cord helix and embedded forged steel guide lugs.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Track pitch, width, lug height, carcass tensile breaking force, rubber-to-metal bonding adhesion, mud-ejection tread pattern.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Exceptional flotation on swampy paddy soils (ground contact pressure <= 25 kPa); zero track de-tracking under heavy turning loads.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Tensile strength test of steel carcass, peel adhesion test per IS 3400, field durability test.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards FAD 11 Farm Machinery Committee

mapping.evidence_source: FMTTI Agricultural Machinery Test Guidelines; BIS FAD 11
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Prescribes dimensional and strength specifications for rubber crawler tracks used on combine harvesters.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national standard for combine harvester rubber tracks.

new_standard.title: Agricultural Machinery — Chaff Cutter (Power Driven) — Safety and Performance Requirements
new_standard.scope: Specifies safety and performance requirements for power-driven chaff cutters used for chopping green and dry fodder for livestock.
new_standard.materials: Steel frame, feed rollers, cutting flywheel with tempered blades, safety reverse-gear mechanism.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Throughput capacity (t/h), power consumption, cutting blade hardness (45 to 52 HRC), mandatory safety chute length (min 900 mm preventing hands reaching feed rollers), emergency stop lever, warning markings.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Elimination of operator hand amputation accidents; uniform chop length.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Safety distance measurement per Annex A, blade hardness per IS 1586, continuous operation test per IS 7897.

mapping.evidence_source: Ministry of Agriculture Chaff Cutter Safety Guidelines; SMAM Subsidy Testing Norms
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Mandatory compliance with safety features and feeding chute dimensions of IS 7897 for all power chaff cutters.

Chaff Cutters (Power Driven).investigation_notes: Formulated by FAD 11. Mandatory operator safety code.

new_standard.title: Hydraulic Power Sprayers — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements, performance and testing of hydraulic power sprayers, including 12V battery-operated knapsack sprayers for pesticide spraying.
new_standard.materials: UV-stabilized HDPE tank (16L), 12V DC diaphragm pump, rechargeable lithium/lead-acid battery, brass/plastic spray lance with hollow cone nozzle.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Tank capacity, pump discharge rate (min 1.5 to 3.0 l/min), working pressure (0.2 to 0.4 MPa), battery backup time (min 4 to 6 hours continuous), lance drop impact test, chemical resistance of tank plastic.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Uniform spray droplet spectrum (VMD 150-250 microns); zero chemical leakage onto operator's back.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Discharge measurement test, tank drop test from 1.2 m per Annex B, chemical compatibility test per IS 11313.

new_standard.title: Farm Drainage and Plant Protection Equipment — Knapsack Sprayers (Piston/Diaphragm Type) — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements, construction, and testing of manually operated knapsack sprayers for agricultural chemical spraying.
new_standard.materials: Brass or engineering plastic cylinder, mechanical hand lever, pressure chamber, spray lance with trigger cutoff valve.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Tank capacity (10 to 16 litres), hydraulic proof pressure test of pressure chamber (1.0 MPa for 5 minutes), discharge rate (min 500 ml/min at 0.3 MPa), mechanical endurance test (50,000 continuous pumping cycles).
new_standard.performance_requirements: Fatigue life without pump cylinder cracking or diaphragm rupture; chemical corrosion resistance.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Hydrostatic pressure test, pump volumetric efficiency test, endurance testing machine per Annex B.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards FAD 11 Farm Machinery Committee

mapping.evidence_source: Ministry of Agriculture SMAM Guidelines; FMTTI Testing Norms
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Mandatory testing and BIS conformity to IS 3906 for all manual and pneumatic knapsack sprayers.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory testing standard for knapsack sprayers.

new_standard.title: Agricultural Machinery — Self-Propelled Rice Transplanter — Test Code
new_standard.scope: Specifies test procedures and performance requirements for ride-on and walk-behind self-propelled paddy transplanters (4-row, 6-row, 8-row).
new_standard.materials: Lightweight chassis, rubber lugged paddy wheels, petrol/diesel engine, seedling tray feeder, rotary transplanting claws.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Row spacing (standard 300 mm), hill spacing (120 to 180 mm), seedlings per hill (2 to 5), missing hill percentage (max 5%), floating seedling percentage (max 3%), field capacity (ha/h).
new_standard.performance_requirements: Smooth planting in wet puddled soil without sinking; minimal seedling damage.
new_standard.testing_requirements: FMTTI field test: 25 hours continuous transplanting test, missing hill counting, planting depth uniformity.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards FAD 11 / Ministry of Agriculture SMAM

mapping.evidence_source: Ministry of Agriculture SMAM Guidelines; FMTTI Test Protocol
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Compulsory FMTTI testing conforming to IS 16676 for all self-propelled rice transplanters under national farm mechanization subsidies.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory testing standard for self-propelled rice transplanters in India.

new_standard.title: Rotary Tillers (Rotavators) — Test Code and Performance Requirements
new_standard.scope: Specifies test codes, constructional requirements and performance evaluation for tractor PTO-driven rotary tillers (rotavators).
new_standard.materials: Heavy duty tubular frame, central or side gear drive, PTO cardan shaft with shear bolt safety clutch, rotor shaft with boron steel L or C blades.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Tillage depth (up to 150 mm), pulverized mean mass diameter (MMD <= 15 mm), field capacity, blade hardness (IS 6690: 42 to 48 HRC), fuel consumption.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Smooth seedbed preparation in single pass; high wear life in abrasive rocky/sandy soils.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Field pulverization test per Annex B, PTO torque and power measurement per Annex C, blade wear test.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards FAD 11 / Ministry of Agriculture SMAM

mapping.evidence_source: Ministry of Agriculture SMAM Directives; FMTTI Test Code
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Mandatory commercial testing at FMTTI conforming to IS 17045 for rotavators commercialized in India.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory performance and testing standard for tractor rotavators.

mapping.evidence_source: Ministry of Agriculture SMAM Directives; FMTTI
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Clause 1: Prescribes testing and performance standards for tractor PTO-driven rotary tillers.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory standard for tractor PTO driven rotavators.

new_standard.title: Sowing Equipment — Seed-cum-Fertilizer Drills — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements and test methods for tractor-drawn and bullock-drawn seed-cum-fertilizer drills for sowing wheat, pulses, and oilseeds.
new_standard.materials: Steel frame, separate seed and fertilizer hoppers, fluted roller metering mechanism, furrow openers (disc or shoe type).
new_standard.technical_requirements: Calibration accuracy (variation in seed rate between runs <= 5%, variation between furrow openers <= 7%), fertilizer delivery rate uniformity, seed damage percentage (max 1.0%), mechanical seed hopper agitator.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Uniform sowing depth and germination spacing; corrosion resistance against chemical fertilizers.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Calibration test on test bench per Annex A, seed damage test per Annex B.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards FAD 11 / Ministry of Agriculture SMAM

mapping.evidence_source: Ministry of Agriculture SMAM Guidelines; FMTTI Testing Protocol
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Mandatory commercial test report conforming to IS 6813 for all seed drills subsidized under government agricultural programs.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory testing standard for seed cum fertilizer drills in India.

new_standard.title: Power Threshers — General and Safety Requirements
new_standard.scope: Specifies general constructional and mandatory safety requirements for power-operated threshers for wheat, paddy, soybean, and pulses.
new_standard.materials: Heavy steel structure, spike tooth / rasp bar threshing cylinder, concave, aspirator blower, cleaning sieves, feeding chute.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Mandatory feeding chute dimensions (safety chute length min 900 mm), covered flywheels and belts, threshing efficiency (min 98.0%), grain breakage (max 2.0%), clean grain output (min 97.0%).
new_standard.performance_requirements: Elimination of operator hand entanglements in threshing cylinder; high multi-crop throughput.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Safety distance measurement per Annex A, threshing efficiency and grain loss evaluation per IS 6284.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards FAD 11 / Dangerous Machines (Regulation) Act

mapping.evidence_source: Dangerous Machines (Regulation) Act 1983; Ministry of Agriculture SMAM Guidelines
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Statutory requirement under Dangerous Machines Act: all power threshers manufactured or sold must strictly conform to safety specifications of IS 9020.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory safety and performance standard for power threshers in India.

Threshers (Multi-Crop).investigation_notes: Formulated by FAD 11. Enforced under the Dangerous Machines (Regulation) Act.

new_standard.title: Tractor-Mounted Disc Harrows — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements for tractor-mounted and trailed disc harrows (offset and tandem types) for secondary tillage and weed cutting.
new_standard.materials: Structural steel frame, high carbon steel dished discs (conforming to IS 4366), sealed ball bearing spools, gang angle adjusting mechanism.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Disc diameter (450 to 660 mm), concavity, disc hardness (38 to 44 HRC), gang angle adjustment (up to 24 degrees), penetration depth.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Uniform soil pulverization and residue incorporation without disc cracking or bearing seizure.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Hardness test per IS 1586, disc impact toughness test per IS 4366, field endurance testing.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards FAD 11 Farm Machinery Committee

mapping.evidence_source: FMTTI Agricultural Implements Test Code; BIS FAD 11
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Prescribes construction, dimensions and disc quality for tractor mounted disc harrows.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national standard for tractor drawn disc harrows.

new_standard.title: Tractor-Mounted Disc Ploughs — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements for tractor-mounted heavy-duty disc ploughs (2-bottom, 3-bottom, 4-bottom) for primary deep tillage in hard dry soils.
new_standard.materials: Heavy tubular/channel steel frame, heat-treated high carbon dished discs, adjustable furrow wheel, category II 3-point linkage hitch.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Disc diameter (660 to 710 mm), disc thickness (6 mm), tilt angle (15° to 25°), disc angle (40° to 45°), working depth (up to 300 mm).
new_standard.performance_requirements: Inversion of hard compacted soil and root cutting without disc chipping; stable tracking behind tractor.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Linkage geometry per IS 4468, disc hardness per IS 1586, drawbar load and furrow inversion test.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards FAD 11 Farm Machinery Committee

mapping.evidence_source: FMTTI Agricultural Implements Test Code; BIS FAD 11
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Prescribes design and performance criteria for heavy duty tractor mounted disc ploughs.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national standard for tractor disc ploughs.

Sugarcane Harvesters and Cutters.investigation_notes: Commercial field testing is conducted by FMTTI Budni under Ministry of Agriculture guidelines, but a dedicated Indian Standard is currently under drafting in BIS Committee FAD 11 (Farm Machinery) and has not yet been enacted in a final Gazette QCO notification.
